results.name: Tropical Storm Sara in Honduras
results.reason: On the 16 November 2024 at 23:30 Tropical Storm Sara hit Honduras. Specifically, floods and mass movements have been reported to affect the country. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation emergency mapping.
